title: Mature Tree

stage.name: Mature tree
stage.description: Wide roots, thick bark and a full canopy. Still growing, ring by ring.

questions.prompt: Where do most tree roots grow?
options: In the upper soil, spreading wide
questions.why: Most roots sit in the top few feet of soil and often spread wider than the canopy.

questions.prompt: What do mycorrhizal fungi do for tree roots?
options: Help them take in nutrients in return for sugar
questions.why: The fungus reaches nutrients the roots can't, and the tree pays with sugar.

questions.prompt: A full-size tree has stopped growing.
questions.why: Trees keep adding wood and new shoots for as long as they live.

questions.prompt: What's the relationship version of a tree's underground network?
options: Family, friends and community who support you both
Depending only on each other for everything
Keeping your relationship away from everyone
questions.why: Couples do better with people around them who want them to succeed.

talk: Who could be part of the network that supports you as a couple?
